forks.consequence: The Trial. Kell has accepted. Everything left on Donegal watches.

tracks.name: The Road to Marsdenville
tracks.situation: The Exiles are falling back on the Third Royal Guards at New Marsdenville, and Ward is on them. Cover the retreat. The Exiles will not leave a crippled Point behind, which means neither can you.
tracks.deployment: Short edges, same-edge start. You (Defender) and the Exiles enter from the Empire edge Turn 1; the Empire (Attacker) enters its own edge Turn 2. The Guards' picket line is on your home edge (Donegal Guards complication if rolled). Road paved; farmland either side.

objectives.text: Gauntlet — exit half your force by count off your home edge; crippled units that make it count.
Bring the Wounded — exit a crippled Exile or friendly unit off your home edge.
Bite Back — cripple or destroy 25% of the Empire force.
Run Them Down — cripple or destroy half your force before it exits.

tracks.specialRules: Exile units will not exit while a crippled friendly is within 3 hexes of an Empire unit. A track win adds to Exiles Stand.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 8.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Defender keeps none unless the Attacker fails to win; then owners recover their own.

forks.trigger: Ward has sent a second batchall: a Trial, Star Colonel to Star Colonel, before the Guards' lines.
forks.consequence: The Trial. Kell has accepted, whatever the road cost.

tracks.name: The Trial of the Exiles
tracks.situation: Ward against Kell, or Ward against you if Kell is down — one on one, on the plain, with both Clusters standing off to watch. The Wolves' way to end a family argument. Whoever wins the Trial wins Donegal's Hinterlands; the Exiles' survival rides on it.
tracks.deployment: Both champions set up 10 hexes apart at map center on open ground (Level 0–1, no woods). All other units set up on their own home edge and MAY NOT move or fire until the Trial ends. Trial ends when one champion is crippled or destroyed. Then, if both sides have units left, the watching forces may engage for the remaining turns.

objectives.text: Win the Trial — your champion cripples or destroys Star Colonel Ward's Timber Wolf.
Hold the Field — more non-crippled BV/PV within 6 hexes of center than the Empire at end of Turn 10.
Win the Trial — Ward cripples or destroys your champion.

tracks.specialRules: Any unit that interferes in the Trial: its side forfeits the Trial objective and -2 Reputation with the Exiles. If your side wins, the Exiles claim the Cluster's survivors as bondsmen and Exiles Stand +2. At contract close: 2+ = the bonus; 0 = a Clan ends on Donegal.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 10, or when one side has no non-crippled 'Mechs within 6 hexes of center after the Trial ends.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Winner-all — the Trial's winner claims the field; the Exiles' isorla first.

forks.trigger: The family argument is settled, for a generation.
forks.consequence: Contract closes; settle Exiles Stand and Reputation.

hotspots.title: The Sabari Wastes
hotspots.employer: Lyran Commonwealth — Eighth Lyran Regulars (Bolan Province)
hotspots.blurb: Bolan came back to the Commonwealth in June with water purifiers and a regiment. The Free Worlds League wants it back. Two employers, one desert world, and a border that has moved four times in fifteen years.

a.employer: Lyran Commonwealth — Eighth Lyran Regulars (Bolan Province)

contract.constraints: Command House — the Eighth Lyran Regulars direct the province's defense. Salvage Shared: the Regulars claim half of every League wreck for the Bolan Jaegers they are raising; your half is real.
contract.additionalRequirements: Track Scale 2 or higher; minimum fielded force 5,500 BV / 220 PV. Desert-capable — 0.78 g and 80°C interiors; heat management matters.
contract.bonus: The province holds — if Bolan City and the water works are Lyran at contract end, +2 Reputation with the Lyran Commonwealth and the Melissa Steiner Martial Academy's graduating lance offered to your command at no cost.

a.blurb: Hold Bolan for the Commonwealth — the League's Tamarind-Abbey regiment is coming back for the world it lost in June, and the Eighth Regulars cannot hold the city and the wastes both.
a.situation: Bolan was League for five years and Lyran for five months, and the people chose Lyran because the Eighth Regulars brought water purifiers when the League brought garrison troops. Now Duke Marik's Tamarind-Abbey regiment is in-system to reverse it. The Regulars hold Bolan City; you hold the Sabari approach — the desert road the League must come up — and the water works that decided the last vote.

b.employer: Free Worlds League — Tamarind-Abbey expeditionary command (Duke Marik's regiment)

contract.constraints: Command House — the Duke's regimental commander sets the axis; the League wants the city, not a desert. Salvage Exchange: the League claims the Lyran hardware; you take cash.
contract.additionalRequirements: Track Scale 2 or higher; a force that can move fast across desert — the Sabari road is the only way in and the Regulars will hold it.
contract.bonus: Bolan returned — take the water works (Track 2b) or win two of three tracks, and the League pays a province bonus: +1 Reputation with the Free Worlds League and priority refit at the Tamarind yards.

b.blurb: Fight for the League — retake Bolan from the Regulars who took it with water purifiers and a smile, before the Commonwealth digs in for another fifteen years.
b.situation: The Commonwealth took Bolan in June with a regiment and a humanitarian shipment, and the people let them. Duke Marik does not accept a vote held at the barrel of a purifier. Land on the Sabari Wastes, force the desert road, and take the water works the Regulars used to buy the world — then Bolan City, before the Lyrans can reinforce from York.

hotspots.situation:
Bolan is a desert world of mountains and salt oceans where everyone lives on the polar coasts because the equatorial interior reaches eighty degrees and the third continent has been uninhabitable since the First Succession War. It has changed hands four times since 3137. The Lyrans staged an invasion of the League from it. The Wolves broke a regiment on it and left. The League took it in 3146. And in May 3151 the Eighth Lyran Regulars landed with a water-purification convoy and a general who understood that on Bolan, water is the vote — and by June the League's garrison had gone and the population had, without anyone quite asking them, chosen the Commonwealth.

Duke Fontaine Marik's Tamarind-Abbey command does not consider a vote bought with purifiers to be a vote. In 3152 it is back in-system with a regiment and a plan: land on the Sabari Wastes, where nobody can stop a landing, force the desert road north to the water works, and take back the thing the Lyrans used to buy the world. The Eighth Regulars can hold Bolan City or the road, not both. The Commonwealth has hired for the road. The League has hired for the assault.

This is the contract, from either side. The Sabari road — the only route up from the wastes to the coast — and the water works at its head that decided the last vote and will decide the next. The ground is 0.78 g and the interior is an oven. Both employers are paying for the same three tracks, and only one of them gets Bolan.

contract.constraints: Command House — the Eighth Lyran Regulars direct the province's defense. Salvage Shared: the Regulars claim half of every League wreck; your half is real.
contract.additionalRequirements: Track Scale 2 or higher; minimum fielded force 5,500 BV / 220 PV. Desert-capable — 0.78 g and 80°C interiors.
contract.bonus: The province holds — if Bolan City and the water works are Lyran at contract end, +2 Reputation with the Lyran Commonwealth and a Melissa Steiner Martial Academy lance offered at no cost.

missionBrief.behindScenes: Colonel Ansel Halas commands the League regiment; Leutnant-General Ruth Ludwig-Steiner the Regulars. Track 1 is the meeting on the road — the League coming up, the Lyrans coming down to stop them. If the Lyran side wins, the League falls back to the wastes and the Lyrans pursue (2a). If the League wins, the water works are next (2b). Track 3 is Bolan City's southern gate, whichever side is attacking it.

complications.effect: None.
Desert heat. Any unit that ends its turn on open sand (no building, no Level 2+ hex) takes +2 heat from Turn 3, both sides, all track.
Bolan militia. Two Bolan militia 'Mechs (Green) join the LYRAN side on Turn 3 — the population picked. They will not leave the water works' vicinity.
Low gravity. 0.78 g: all units +1 MP running and +1 jump this track. Falls from Level 2+ do no damage.
The Academy. A Melissa Steiner Martial Academy cadet lance (Green) holds the Sabari Wastes campus on the LEAGUE's approach. They fight for the Lyrans if attacked; otherwise they watch.
Roll twice, ignore repeats.

missionBrief.contractVictory: LYRAN: Bolan City and the water works are Lyran at contract end. LEAGUE: the water works are taken or two of three tracks won. The contract pays on the road; the bonus pays on the works.
missionBrief.tally: Road Held — each track your side wins counts 1. At 2+, your employer's bonus pays. At 0, -1 Reputation with your employer: Bolan changed hands a fifth time, and not your way.

namedCharacters.name: Colonel Ansel Halas
namedCharacters.role: Free Worlds League — Tamarind-Abbey regiment commander
namedCharacters.rule: League side commander from Track 1. If crippled, the League does not attack Bolan City in Track 3 — it holds the works if it has them, or withdraws.

namedCharacters.name: Leutnant-General Ruth Ludwig-Steiner
namedCharacters.role: Lyran Commonwealth — Eighth Lyran Regulars commander
namedCharacters.rule: Lyran side commander from Track 1. If crippled, the Regulars hold the city only; the works are yours to hold or lose in Track 2b/3 alone.

missionBrief.purchaseOptions: Between tracks, what Bolan City has — light and medium 'Mechs on a 2D6 roll of 9+ (the province was League five years ago and the depots went with it). League side: the Tamarind yards by DropShip, heavies on 8+.

tracks.name: The Sabari Road
tracks.situation:
The League is coming up the desert road from the wastes; the Regulars are coming down it to stop them. They meet at the Sakété escarpment where the road climbs off the sand. Nobody dictates this one. The desert does.

Meeting engagement: both sides arrive at once; neither has prepared the ground.
tracks.deployment: Long edges. Both sides set up within 6 hexes of their home edge — the road climbs from Level 0 sand (League edge) to a Level 2 escarpment (Lyran edge) across the map. Desert-heat and low-gravity rules if rolled. Academy campus (three Light buildings) on the League's left flank if rolled.

objectives.text: Hold the Escarpment — half your force within 4 hexes of the escarpment crest at end of Turn 4.
Overpower — more non-crippled BV/PV within 6 hexes of the crest than the enemy at end of Turn 10.
Cut Off the Head — cripple or destroy the enemy commander's 'Mech.

tracks.specialRules: A track win adds to Road Held.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 10, or when one side has no non-crippled 'Mechs within 6 hexes of the crest.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Lyran: Shared. League: Exchange.

forks.trigger: The road is decided. The loser is falling back and the winner is on them.
forks.consequence: The pursuit across the wastes — or the retreat, depending on your side.

forks.trigger: The road is decided. The water works are next.
forks.consequence: The works that bought the world. Hold them or take them.

tracks.name: Across the Wastes
tracks.situation: The road's loser is falling back across the Sabari Wastes to its DropShips; the winner is running it down before it can regroup. Open sand, no cover, and an interior that kills 'Mechs that stand still.
tracks.deployment: Long edges. The pursued side (Defender) sets up in a column in the northern third heading for its home edge; the pursuer (Attacker) enters Turn 1 from the south. All open sand (Level 0), scattered Level 1 dunes. Desert-heat rules if rolled.

objectives.text: Run Them Down — engage half the enemy force before it reaches its home edge.
Cut the Road — hold two road hexes in the northern third at end of Turn 6.
Hammer — first side to cripple 25% of the enemy scores it; simultaneous, both score.
Reach the Ships — exit half the pursued force by BV off its home edge.

tracks.specialRules: The side that won Track 1 is the Attacker here. A track win adds to Road Held.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 6, or when the pursued side has no non-crippled unit on the road.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Lyran: Shared. League: Exchange.

forks.trigger: Whoever holds the road holds the approach to Bolan City's southern gate.
forks.consequence: The gate. The city, and the province.

tracks.name: The Water Works
tracks.situation: The purification works at the head of the Sabari road — the plant that decided the last vote. The League wants it taken intact; the Lyrans want it kept. Whoever holds the control house at the end holds Bolan's argument.
tracks.deployment: Short edges. The Lyran side (Defender) sets up within 6 hexes of the works — a Heavy control house (Level 3) and four Medium tanks (Level 2) at center of its half; the League (Attacker) enters Turn 1. No unit may fire on the control house — both sides need it working.

objectives.text: Hold the House — more non-crippled BV/PV within 3 hexes of the control house than the enemy, Turn 8.
Keep the Tanks — three of four tanks standing at end of Turn 8.
Cut Off the Head — cripple or destroy the enemy commander's 'Mech.
Reach the House — a League unit adjacent to the control house at end of any turn from Turn 5.

tracks.specialRules: Any side that damages the control house loses 200 VP. Bolan-militia complication joins the Lyran side here. A track win adds to Road Held.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 8.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Lyran: Shared. League: Exchange.

forks.trigger: The works are decided. Bolan City's southern gate is the last thing on the road.
forks.consequence: The gate. Whoever attacks it is attacking the province.

tracks.name: The Southern Gate
tracks.situation: Bolan City's southern gate — where the Sabari road enters the capital. If the League holds the road, it assaults; if the Lyrans do, the League makes one last try from the wastes. Either way the province is decided at the gate.
tracks.deployment: Short edges. The Lyran side (Defender) sets up within 6 hexes of the gate — a Heavy gatehouse (Level 3) and the city's outer buildings (Medium, Level 2) on its edge; the League (Attacker) enters Turn 1 up the road. If the League's commander was crippled earlier, the League does not attack — this track is a League withdrawal (Pursuit shape, Lyran attacking).

objectives.text: The Gate — hold the gatehouse and two outer buildings at end of Turn 8.
Overpower — more non-crippled BV/PV within 6 hexes of the gate than the enemy at end of Turn 8.
Cut Off the Head — cripple or destroy the enemy commander's 'Mech.

tracks.specialRules: At contract close: Road Held 2+ = your employer's bonus. Lyran side: the province holds and the Academy lance. League side: Bolan returned and the Tamarind refit.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 8, or when one side holds the gatehouse and both outer buildings at end of a turn.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Lyran: Shared. League: Exchange.

forks.trigger: Bolan has changed hands a fifth time, or not.
forks.consequence: Contract closes; settle Road Held and Reputation with your employer.
